race.comment: THINK I DO (4) was plain last start, but she was back to the mile there and now back out to 2000m and into country level she looks ready to bounce back. She'll lob in a handy position and her form prior to last start was very strong. Can get back to winning ways. PURE MELODY (6) brings the sharper winning form, having beaten SPURLINE in a BM60 at Canberra after also winning a CL1 there, and the weight relief plus strong jockey record with her keep her right in play despite the class rise. BEHTAR (2) has been close enough in two recent fourths and draws to get every chance. He's got peak ratings good enough to win this and his recent efforts suggest they might be within reach. FAIR MASTER (1) was plain at Warwick Farm but his Albury BM66 win two back and one-from-one record at the distance make him a legitimate threat if he rebounds. SPURLINE (5) won well with good splits last start and can feature.
